audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven rows reads Urgot, including 2+ items — while whys[6] on the same page says Feast stacks and true damage flip the duel. The already-audited mirror sets this lane as Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath.
audit.why: The mirror was audited first and the two directions must agree; a sweep of Urgot rows also contradicts this page's own late paragraph. Level 1 is even because Rupture out-ranges him, 4-5 evens on the Feral Scream silence, and everything from 6 onward is Cho'Gath's on Feast.
audit.corrected: Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath with Urgot-side ratings 5,6,6,5,3,3,3 — the inverse of the mirror's 5,4,4,5,7,7,7. Difficulty moved to EVEN 5/10 to match the mirror's 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and whys[5] recommends Bami's — a tank item Urgot does not build; the page's own itemization says Black Cleaver.
audit.why: Rupture 6s at 950, Feral Scream 11s, Feast 80s at rank 1, Purge 12s at rank 1 — those are what turn 'trade when it is down' into a sequence.
audit.corrected: 6s, 11s, 80s and 12s written into the phases, spikes, mid and cooldown breakdown; the Bami's reference dropped.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interaction: Rupture's knockup cancels a Disdain charge outright. wants.foe[1] attributes the silence to his Q; it is Feral Scream (W). spikes[1] argues a fat Cho'Gath is what your execute wants.
audit.why: Riot: Rupture pops enemies into the air — a knockup lands on you mid-charge and the charge ends. Feral Scream is the cone silence, and silencing your Purge cast is what loses you the trade. Feast is true damage, so armour and Disdain's shield do nothing against it. Riot's Fear Beyond Death text says only 'falls below a health threshold' — nothing settles whether a bigger pool helps or hurts you, so I did not argue either way.
audit.corrected: Knockup-cancels-Disdain written into phases[2]; the silence attributed to Feral Scream; Feast described as true damage that ignores your armour and shield; the fat-Cho'Gath execute claim removed rather than reversed.

edits.before: Q start for safe poke. Each auto fires an Echoing Flames leg — chunk Cho'Gath on every last-hit, but don't burn all six legs into one trade.

edits.before: Q and W ranks make the grind trades brutal. Force Cho'Gath to choose between CS and health; he can't have both into your spray.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Cho'Gath is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Cho'Gath to trade into the spike.
edits.after: His first item plus Feast stacks outgrow your damage curve. Shove, take plates, and stop trying to solo him in the open lane.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Cho'Gath must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Six Feast stacks and full tank beat you head-on, and his R is true damage that your resistances never touch. Shred him for your team, don't duel him.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture (Knockup): matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it and poke. Track it before every engage. - Cho'Gath Rupture: Delayed ground spike that knocks up and slows — telegraphed. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — 6s at rank 1, 950 range, delayed, and the knockup cancels a Disdain charge. - Cho'Gath Feast: 80s at rank 1, true damage, and it grows his health pool on a kill.

notes: Chart rebuilt to the mirror's shape — the page had all seven rows as Urgot while its own late paragraph said a 6-stack Feast Cho'Gath out-durabilities you. NOT written: champ-data/_kits/_missing/urgot.json claims Rupture grounds Corrosive Charge. That is wrong twice — Riot's Rupture text is a knockup with no grounding (the parser fired on the word 'ground', the same false positive the mirror found), and Corrosive Charge is a ranged charge, not a dash. What I did write is the real interaction: Rupture's knockup cancels a Disdain charge. Also left alone: whether Urgot's execute threshold scales with the target's pool. Riot says only 'falls below a health threshold', so I removed the fat-Cho'Gath argument rather than reversing it.
